Blue's Story Time. It's story time and Blue wants to read her favorite story so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what the story is.
What Does Blue Need?. As we discover what Blue needs, we take the time to help Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper find fruits by describing where they are in relation to each other.
Blue's Favorite Song. It's song time but first, Blue and Steve listen to sounds and figure out the musical instrument, remember the line of a song, and see which chick is singing in tune.
Adventures in Art. Blue and Steve are ready to begin painting. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what else Blue wants to paint in her picture.
Blue Goes to the Beach. Steve and Blue are going to the beach! In this episode, we decide what clothes they should wear, experiment with physics, and help sea creatures find their way back.
Pretend Time. It's pretend time and we need to figure out what Blue wants to pretend to be.
A Snowy Day. It's a snowy day and we need to figure out what Blue wants to do in the snow. We match snowflakes, help Calendar fix her picture, and help Steve see what's missing on Blue.
The Trying Game. Blue wants to practice, but what? We also practice telling time, figure out what Baby Bear wants to be and see what animals will look like when they grow up.
Blue Wants To Play a Game. Blue wants to play a game and we try to figure out which one. Along the way we do a puzzle, find Blue among blue objects, and find our way to the Gingerbread Boy's house.
The Grow Show!. We try to figure out what Blue wants to do outside. As we look for clues we learn where orange juice comes from, learn about length and volume and fruits and vegetables.
Blue Wants To Play a Song Game!. Blue and Steve are playing song games and it's Blue's turn to choose a song. We play Blue's Clues to figure out which song game she wants to play.
What Does Blue Want To Make?. Blue and Steve have just finished making newspaper hats and Blue wants to make something else. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to make.
What Story Does Blue Want To Play?. Blue and Steve just finished putting on a play and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what other story Blue wants to play.
Tickety's Favorite Nursery Rhyme. Blue, Steve, and Tickety are going to read Tickety Tock's favorite nursery rhyme, but which one is it? We play Blue's Clues to figure it out.
What Is Blue Afraid Of?. Blue is scared and we play Blue's Clues to determine what is frightening her.
Magenta Comes Over. Blue has a playdate with her best friend Magenta. We play Blue's Clues to determine what Blue wants to do when Magenta comes over.
